name: tier-ladder
family: speed/quality tier ordering at a held seed
origin: tranche 3b item 1 (Flux a80ekav sqzwroy) + tranche 3a bake-off reuse; scripts ported from test-results/experiments/tranche3b/scripts/{build,run,analyze}_tiers.py
measures: Same-seed cross-tier divergence (pairwise PSNR at f0/f62/f123), ArcFace identity vs the reference still, motion-timing delta (Pearson r, best lag, peak-activity index), per-tier wall-clock, and the blind tier-quality rank (two independent passes: 288px contact sheets + full-res grid).

fixtures.referenceImage: input/exp_bake/ref.png (testbed input asset; the tranche-1 srcA f40 still of the woman, ArcFace det 0.87)
fixtures.prompt: The woman in <Picture 1>, the same person. A pale woman in her early thirties with a short black bob haircut, thin silver hoop earrings, faint freckles, wearing an oversized rust-orange wool coat over a charcoal turtleneck. She stands at a weathered wooden counter in a small sunlit kitchen, slowly stirring a copper pot of soup with a wooden spoon, late-afternoon light through a window to her left; the camera holds a steady medium shot. Audio: gentle simmering, the wooden spoon tapping the copper pot, a quiet kitchen fan hum.

t8.label: turbo tier — larryvrh v4_step600_ema MERGE + TurboSampler, 8 steps

vdn20.label: VDN-arch hero — ApplyVDNH3_24GB stage-dmd-step-250, turbo adapter OFF, 20 steps

incumbentReuse.note: t8/t20 are bit-config-identical to the ref2va-bakeoff main8/ref20 arms at the same seed — the runner reuses those videos instead of re-spending GPU (deterministic graph + fixed noise seed).

candidateSlot.description: A candidate TIER (a sampler/step/LoRA/VDN configuration) becomes a new arm at the held seed and is compared against the four incumbents on every metric. This is the slot for a new distill/stage/quant claiming a better speed/quality point.

slotFields.loraFile: turbo LoRA file name in the testbed loras root (sampler=turbo)
slotFields.unetFile: alternative base checkpoint file name (default: fixtures.models.unetRef2va)
slotFields.vdnCheckpoint: VDN stage name (the VDN-arch path; excludes loraFile)

rubric.contactSheet: 12-up contact sheet of the clip. Judge overall render quality: fabric/hair micro-detail, face definition, color fidelity to a sunlit late-afternoon kitchen (no color collapse, no waxy smear), absence of banding. Rank against the other labeled sheets.
rubric.fullRes: Full-resolution center frame. Judge STILL-FRAME fine detail and micro-contrast only (a still frame cannot see motion smoothness or audio quality — those are NOT part of this rubric).

limits: STILLS-SHARPNESS ONLY: the 2026-09-16 blind finding ranks still-frame detail; turbo's documented costs live on the motion/audio/pinned-row-robustness axes, which this suite does not measure (the robustness-axes caveat).
Single scene, single seed — tranche 3a measured seed spread up to 0.12-0.37 ArcFace within one option, so tier ordering at other seeds may wobble.
Walls include per-run /free reload overhead; contact-sheet pass downsamples to 288px tiles.
t8/t20 rows are REUSED bit-identical artifacts from ref2va-bakeoff at the same seed (deterministic graph + fixed noise).
